title: Key national firsts and launches
summary: **** Bharat Taxi (first cooperative-sector ride-hailing, launched by Amit Shah, 5 Feb).

items: **** Bharat Taxi (first cooperative-sector ride-hailing, launched by Amit Shah, 5 Feb).
CBDC-based PDS (Gandhinagar, first e-Rupee ration system).
Namo Bharat RRTS full 82 km Delhi-Meerut corridor inaugurated (180 km/h).
PM RAHAT scheme (13 Feb) — cashless road-accident treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh/victim for 7 days.
Micron ATMP facility (Sanand, Gujarat) — first proposal under India Semiconductor Mission, >₹22,500 crore.
**** India's first bullet train (Mumbai-Ahmedabad HSR, 508 km) — target **15 August 2027**.
National Sports Governance Act partial implementation (1 Jan 2026).
Coking coal notified Critical & Strategic Mineral (MMDR Act Sec 11C).
77th Republic Day — Chief Guests António Costa & Ursula von der Leyen (16th India-EU Summit, 27 Jan).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — PM RAHAT + CBDC-PDS + Bharat Taxi (Feb); bullet-train target date + Republic Day Chief Guests (Jan).
